content.text:
=== example.org (guide's primary 'New installation' command) ===
web/ present
vendor/ present (48 dirs)
  const VERSION = '11.4.10';
site installed there?
no settings.php (codebase only, not site-installed)

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== example.org (guide's primary 'New installation' command) ==="; ls example.org/web >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "web/ present"; ls example.org/vendor >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "vendor/ present ($(ls example.org/vendor | wc -l) dirs)"; grep -m1 "const VERSION" example.org/web/core/lib/Drupal.php 2>/dev/null; echo "site installed there?"; [ -f example.org/web/sites/default/settings.php ] && echo "settings.php present" || echo "no settings.php (codebase only, not site-installed)"; ls example.org/web/sites/default/files 2>/dev/null >/dev/null && echo "files dir present"
